item.title: Scorpio Herbs: Boundary Medicine of Death & Rebirth | Astro-Herbalism
item.itunes:title: Scorpio Herbs: Boundary Medicine of Death & Rebirth | Astro-Herbalism
item.itunes:subtitle: Why do Scorpio’s plants come armed with thorns, stings and bitter, blood-moving virtues?
item.description:
Why do Scorpio’s plants come armed with thorns, stings and bitter, blood-moving virtues? Herbalists Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs) and Michelle Lundquist join Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies), Slick Dissident and Chance Garton to read mugwort, wormwood, damiana, rose, rose hips, stinging nettle, lemon balm, yellow dock, ashwagandha, calendula and comfrey through astrology and the doctrine of signatures, the old art of reading a plant’s shape, color, scent and growth as clues to its healing gifts.

Scorpio, the fixed water sign of sex, death and regeneration, governs the pelvis, where the organs of generation sit beside the organs of elimination. Its season calls for fasting and letting go, and this panel follows that thread through the Death card and the five petaled Venus Rose, the gate of the great mystery at Antares, and what Kyle calls boundary medicine: the Martian thorns and stings that guard Venus’s gifts.

Remastered from Vibe Rant episode 64 (originally aired November 18, 2022), with improved audio and the tangents trimmed.

item.title: Does Christianity NEED the Devil? Chance Garton & Dawn Lester
item.itunes:title: Does Christianity NEED the Devil? Chance Garton & Dawn Lester
item.itunes:subtitle: The astro-theology of the Devil and the boogeymen waiting on the path of truth-seekers.
item.description:
What does the Devil represent in astrotheolgy? Is there a secret to the serpent of Genesis that tells a Gnostic story?


"The Devil is the grand ally of priests. No Devil, no priests." These words were written by Godfrey Higgins in the 19th century, and truer have never been spoken. In this episode, I join Dawn Lester on her podcast Dawn of Discernment to talk about a nice variety of topics, always circling around to the scripture in the stars, and how to be open to new interpretations of things without getting carried away into new dogmas.

item.title: Exposing the Astrological Errors of Fomenko's New Chronology
item.itunes:title: Exposing the Astrological Errors of Fomenko's New Chronology
item.itunes:subtitle: Does a Renaissance painting contain evidence that nearly 200 years of history were invented?
item.description:
Does a Renaissance painting contain evidence that nearly 200 years of history were invented? Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio investigate Anatoly Fomenko’s New Chronology through the zodiac ceiling of the Sala di Galatea at Rome’s Villa Farnesina.


The conventional interpretation connects the ceiling’s horoscope to Agostino Chigi’s birth in 1466. Fomenko proposes 1656. That difference leads to much bigger claims: phantom duplicates of historical figures, a powerful pope’s family rewriting Italian history, and works attributed to Raphael being reassigned to Carlo Maratta.

In Inner Whirled 32, we examine the artwork panel by panel, compare interpretations of its mythological and planetary symbolism, and check the proposed dates against the sky. What do the sources support? Which planetary placements can we reproduce? And how much depends on the assumptions behind the reading?

item.title: The Tooth Truths Most Dentists Won't Admit, with Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs
item.itunes:title: The Tooth Truths Most Dentists Won't Admit, with Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs
item.itunes:subtitle: How do we take care of our teeth from a terrain medicine perspective?
item.description:
How do we take care of our teeth from a terrain medicine perspective? What does most holistic dentistry tend to get wrong about tooth mineralization, regeneration, and hygiene?

Master herbalist Kyle Denton returns to InnerVerse to explore holistic oral health, dental herbalism, and a terrain perspective on teeth, tongues, and mineralization. Drawing on 15 years working in the dental field, the man behind Tippecanoe Herbs brings a whole-body approach to caring for our mouths. What might your tongue reveal about your body? Why does Kyle approach tooth mineralization from the inside out? And what happens when daily hygiene becomes an opportunity for mental cleansing, too?


We explore traditional tongue assessment, tongue scraping, nutrition, stress, and the connections Kyle draws between dental health and the endocrine system. Along the way, we discuss biofield tuning, kava, black walnut, navigating dental anxiety, and choosing a dentist you can communicate with. It’s a conversation about taking care of ourselves from a place of innate wholeness.

item.title: Libra Herbs: What Makes a Plant Venusian? | Astro-Herbalism
item.itunes:title: Libra Herbs: What Makes a Plant Venusian? | Astro-Herbalism
item.description:
What makes a plant Venusian? In this Libra episode of Astro-Herbalism, we explore the connections between astrology, herbal medicine, and the doctrine of signatures: reading a plant’s shape, color, scent, and growth for clues to its qualities and symbolic meaning. Herbalists Kyle Denton and Michelle Lundquist join me alongside Mario Garza and Slick Dissident to examine how Libra’s themes of balance, beauty, relationship, and discernment appear throughout the plant world.

This is a remaster of an episode that originally aired on October 11, 2023


Along the way, we explore Libra’s Justice and Adjustment tarot imagery, the scales and their central axis, the transition between light and darkness, and the relationship between Venus and the Air element. Plant medicine, mythology, language, and the human body meet in a conversation about recognizing nature’s patterns and developing a more personal relationship with the herbs and trees around us.

item.title: Is Fomenko Legit? | Checking the Receipts On New Chronology
item.itunes:title: Is Fomenko Legit? | Checking the Receipts On New Chronology
item.itunes:subtitle: We put his astronomical dating arguments to the test.
item.description:
Is Fomenko’s New Chronology legit? Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio investigate the evidence behind Anatoly Fomenko’s radical claim that much of ancient history actually happened in the Middle Ages. We put his astronomical dating arguments to the test and ask what would justify rewriting the historical timeline.


Fomenko says the Book of Revelation was written during the Renaissance, and the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse contain a date hidden in symbolism. We explore Nikolai Morozov’s influence on New Chronology, compare his interpretation with Fomenko’s proposed date of 1486 AD, and follow the argument from biblical passages to astronomical reconstruction. Can these methods uncover a verifiable historical date? How much depends on the assumptions used to interpret the text?


✦ EXPLORE INNERVERSE

Biofield Tuning sessions with Chance: https://www.innerversepodcast.com/biofield-tuning

The New InnerVerse App: https://circle.innerversepodcast.com/app

Chapters, Quotes & Notes for this episode: https://www.innerversepodcast.com/episodes/inner-whirled-31


✦ CONTINUE INTO INNERVERSE PLUS

The extended InnerVerse Plus conversation continues into planetary color correspondences, Zechariah’s horse visions, the provenance of historical sources, and Thucydides’ accounts of solar and lunar eclipses. We examine another case for astronomical redating and consider how to distinguish a meaningful historical match from coincidence.

item.title: Why Was Tartaria Erased From The Map? Grand Tartary Explained
item.itunes:title: Why Was Tartaria Erased From The Map? Grand Tartary Explained
item.description:
Why was Tartaria erased from the map? Was the Tartarian Empire a lost civilization, a historical cover-up, or something else? Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio investigate Grand Tartary through original maps, translated Latin inscriptions, and the sources behind the modern Tartaria conspiracy theory.


In Inner Whirled 30, we examine maps by Ortelius, Hondius, and Blaeu from the golden age of European cartography. These elaborate atlases raise fascinating questions—but what does their fine print actually say? We also follow the erased-empire theory back to Anatoly Fomenko’s New Chronology and check the historical evidence cited in his work. What connects Tartary, the Mongol Empire, and Russia? Do the original sources support the story circulating online?


✦ CONTINUE INTO INNERVERSE PLUS

Get the extended episode, featuring the 1771 Encyclopedia Britannica entries on Tartaria, the Tartarian Empire's Flags, and the account of a Dutch East India Company embassy to the Great Tartar Khan from the 16th century.

item.title: Nathan Oakley | Why the Globe Needs a Flat Earth
item.itunes:title: Nathan Oakley | Why the Globe Needs a Flat Earth
item.description:
Why does Nathan Oakley say the globe needs a flat Earth? The author of Measured Flat: All Roads Lead to Flat Earth joins Chance Garton on InnerVerse to explore his argument that the globe model depends on fundamental flat measurements. What does an elevation angle actually measure? Why do you level a compass, and why are north and up different directions? Nathan connects these questions to celestial navigation, sextants, Polaris, and the distinction between observation, calculation, and scientific experimentation.


This conversation follows Nathan’s critique of globe geometry into mapping, Earth’s magnetism, and explanations of its interior. Along the way, we examine the language of scientific authority, the mental effort of following increasingly complicated explanations, and what happens when an answer sounds convincing without becoming understandable.


How do we distinguish something we can measure from something a model asks us to assume?


Enjoy the new features for this episode at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/episodes/nathanoakley1980


✦ CONTINUE INTO INNERVERSE PLUS

Watch the complete conversation, including nearly an hour of additional discussion exploring calculations of the distance to the sun, gas pressure and containment, gravity, and the burden of proof. Nathan also turns his criticism toward Tartaria, mud-flood narratives, and the incentives shaping online conspiracy content.


InnerVerse Plus+ is best on the InnerVerse website: https://www.innerversepodcast.com/plus/nathanoakley1980

item.title: What Connects Christianity, Tarot & the Stars? Astrotheology 101 with Chance Garton & Meg Moonbeam
item.itunes:title: What Connects Christianity, Tarot & the Stars? Astrotheology 101 with Chance Garton & Meg Moonbeam
item.description:
What connects Christianity, Tarot, and the stars? In Astrotheology 101, Chance Garton joins Meg Moonbeam to explore the celestial symbolism woven through biblical stories, sacred art, and even familiar nursery rhymes.


Why do a man, an eagle, a bull, and a lion appear around Christ, represent the four evangelists, and occupy the corners of the World and Wheel of Fortune tarot cards? What connects these figures to the fixed signs of the zodiac—and what changes when we begin reading the sky as a language?


This illustrated InnerVerse × Meg Moonbeam swapcast introduces astrotheology through recognizable examples, then follows the connections into mythology, astrology, and Christian symbolism. Chance presents his interpretation of how constellations, seasonal patterns, star names, and wordplay became ingredients in stories passed down through generations.


✦ IN THIS EPISODE

  • What astrotheology means—and how to approach it
  • Mother Goose, “Hey Diddle Diddle,” and the constellations
  • Cygnus the Swan, sacred geese, and initiation symbolism
  • The Hamsa, Mary, Miriam, and traditions of spiritual purity
  • The tetramorph: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John
  • Aquarius, Scorpio, Taurus, and Leo in Christian iconography
  • The four Royal Stars and the seven lamps of Revelation
  • The World and Wheel of Fortune in the Rider–Waite–Smith Tarot
  • Free will, gnosis, and “as above, so below”
  • Why exploring celestial symbolism need not undermine Christian faith


Were familiar stories placed among the stars—or were people reading the sky and bringing its language into their stories?


✦ CONTINUE INTO INNERVERSE PLUS

The extended discussion explores Jesus and solar symbolism, the Sacred Heart and Leo, the Lamb and Aries, Virgo and the virgin birth, Mary as Stella Maris, and further correspondences involving Venus, Moses, and Miriam.

item.title: Virgo Season Herbs: Gentle Plant Medicine for Digestion, Nerves & Calm | Astro Herbalism
item.itunes:title: Virgo Season Herbs: Gentle Plant Medicine for Digestion, Nerves & Calm | Astro Herbalism
item.description:
Virgo, the physician of the zodiac, rules the gut, the harvest, and the humble herbs that heal without fanfare. In this remastered Astro Herbalism episode, Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs, Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies, Michelle Lundquist of Michelle's Healing Home, and Slick Dissident join Chance Garton to explore the mutable earth sign through its plants, its myths, and its medicine.

We weigh the Hermit card as an elder shepherd carrying the lamb, trace the Virgin from the Mesopotamian furrow to the fleur de lis, and ask why the gut prefers to stay hidden. Then the herbs: Chamomile, the gentle healer that proves soft can still be strong; Queen Anne's Lace, the wild carrot with the single drop of blood at its center; the Madonna Lily and its long lineage of virgin birth symbolism; Milky Oats for burnt out nerves; Corn Silk and the hairy, hidden wisdom of whole grains; and Wood Betony, the forgotten herb that reconnects a busy head to its gut instincts.

This remaster (originally recorded in 2023) has cleaner audio and a tighter cut, turning a rambling livestream into a focused master class on Virgo, discernment, digestion, and the doctrine of signatures.

Herbal content in this episode is shared for educational purposes only and is not medical advice. Consult a qualified practitioner before using any herb, especially during pregnancy.

item.description:

The conversation then opens into an extended exploration of The Fool and The Magician, Mercury symbolism, Orion, the hero’s journey, spiritual incarnation and the Tarot as a pictorial map of human consciousness.

item.itunes:title: Tartaria Exposed: Sacred Cows & the Psychology of Conspiracy | Chance Garton on HFTT ep. 313
item.description:
Chance Garton returns for his third visit to Here for the Truth, and his first in four years — biofield tuning practitioner, host of the Innerverse Podcast, and one of the rare researchers willing to take the Tartaria conspiracy seriously enough to check its claims against the primary sources. Once a believer himself, Chance traces how the “Old World reset” narrative of mud floods, buried cities, and buildings too beautiful for ordinary people to have built snowballed into a grand unifying theory that now operates like a religion inside truther culture. Underneath the debunking is the conversation that matters: how identity fuses with belief, why “they lied to us” becomes permission to believe anything, and what it costs to hand your discernment to a guru. A study in the one discipline every truth-seeker needs — the courage to hold no sacred cows.

item.title: Jason & The Argonauts: The Greek Myth That Wasn’t Greek
item.itunes:title: Jason & The Argonauts: The Greek Myth That Wasn’t Greek
item.description:
Was Jason really a Greek hero? Was the Argonautica inherited from an older Etruscan or Egyptian tradition? And how much of what we call ancient history began as mythology written in the stars?


Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio investigate the strange provenance of Jason, the Argo and the Golden Fleece, beginning with the surviving Greek literary record. The trail leads into Etruria, where Hason / Heasun appears in artifacts and inscriptions, and into Egypt, where the celestial ship Argo presents an astronomical problem for a supposedly Greek origin. The episode traces the solar symbolism of the Golden Fleece, Aries and Ares, the “shepherd of the people” archetype, and the linguistic trail connecting Jason, Hason, Esus and the Greek name translated as Jesus.

item.title: Was Chicago Firebombed? Tartaria & the Great Fire Conspiracy
item.itunes:title: Was Chicago Firebombed? Tartaria & the Great Fire Conspiracy
item.itunes:subtitle: Tartaria theory says the Great Chicago Fire of 1871 was firebombed to erase the Old World. Is it possible?
item.description:
Tartaria theory says the Great Chicago Fire of 1871 was firebombed to erase the Old World. Is this alternative history conspiracy possible?


The ruins from the great fire really do resemble a bombed out city. Could the brick and limestone buildings of Old Chicago collapse to rubble from an ordinary fire? Were the streets and sidewalks themselves burning? Why couldn't the firemen stop the blaze? And why is the official cause undetermined, 150 years later?

My investigation looks at Chicago's construction methods, the amount of wood in the city, weather conditions of the time, "fireproof" buildings, surviving "Old World" architecture, martial law, and the consolidation of power by the city's industrial elites in the wake of the conflagration.


Watch Video Episode - https://youtu.be/rQpB64bym8w

item.itunes:title: This Guy Claimed He Found a Tartaria Witness. Is it Real?
item.description:
There's one obvious question about the Tartaria old world reset theory that nobody in the genre wants to answer: if settlers really walked into cities that were already standing, somebody's ancestor saw it happen. So where are the accounts?

A viewer named Jack left a comment on the Luminary Lighthouse channel claiming his family had exactly that story, a high-ranking Mason ancestor sent to populate a Kansas town that was already fully built out, granite buildings, a capitol in the center, and a hidden journal to prove it. Logan invited him on for a live stream to tell it in full.

I checked every claim these guys made, and the fibbs piled up higher than a cataclysmic mudflood....

item.title: Can You Prove Earth Is Round? Tamara Sheville's Level Plane Poems
item.itunes:title: Can You Prove Earth Is Round? Tamara Sheville's Level Plane Poems
item.description:
Can you actually prove the Earth is a rotating globe? Before recording this episode, I tried to falsify Flat Earth and find the strongest case for the conventional globe model, and couldn't.

Tamara Sheville joins InnerVerse to put the globe on trial through a rapid-fire examination of curvature, level water, horizons, Antarctica, long-distance visibility, Polaris, atmospheric pressure, vacuum experiments, Foucault's pendulum, Earth rotation, gravity, planetary observations, and the classic disappearing-ship argument.

This isn't built around one supposed “proof.” The question is: what happens when the assumptions behind the globe are examined one after another against measurement, observation and experiment.

item.title: You Can't Prove Atoms Exist, w/ PhD Steven Young (Hedflux) & Marty Leeds (Gnostic Academy)
item.itunes:title: You Can't Prove Atoms Exist, w/ PhD Steven Young (Hedflux) & Marty Leeds (Gnostic Academy)
item.itunes:subtitle: Nobody has ever seen an atom.
item.description:
Nobody has ever seen an atom. Physics PhD Dr. Steven Young (Hedflux) and Marty Leeds of the Gnostic Academy put atomic theory and particle physics on trial.

No direct observation, no repeatable experiment, no proof. In this episode we work through what the evidence for atoms actually consists of: bumps on graphs, microscopes that presuppose the atoms they claim to reveal, and a mind-spell to make you feel small. From there the conversation widens into the periodic table that is not periodic, the one proton that supposedly turns gold into mercury, Mendeleev's erased ether, the boondoggle economics of CERN, and the older map the moderns replaced: earth, air, water, fire, and the living ether.

item.itunes:title: Tartaria and 1800s Insane Asylums: Debunking the Conspiracy Claims with Historical Records
item.description:
Everyone in the Tartaria and mudflood space points at the giant 1800s insane asylums: too big, too grand, built too fast, records too thin. So I went and found the records.

Full show notes linked at the bottom of the post (80 page document).


Watch the video episode:https://youtu.be/4rKtsGZSOx4


This is a full evidence check on two of the most talked-about asylum castles in North America: the Toronto Provincial Lunatic Asylum at 999 Queen Street West, tested against the claims of a popular Tartaria website, and the Utah Territorial Insane Asylum in Provo, tested against a 90,000-view JonLevi video. We go through the architects' journals, the original blueprints, the contractor's bid, the newspaper fights between counties, the cornerstone plaques recovered from the rubble, and the murdered architect that nobody in this genre ever bothered to look up. I used to believe this stuff. I wanted it to be true. What does paper trail actually show? A verdict on whether the old world civilization cover-up has any plausibility at all.

item.title: Was the Book of Revelation Rewritten? Crrow777 w/ Chance Garton
item.itunes:title: Was the Book of Revelation Rewritten? Crrow777 w/ Chance Garton
item.description:
What if the Book of Revelation did not reach us through the simple, unbroken chain of transmission most people imagine?


In my first appearance on CRROW777 Radio, I join Crrow777 and Jason Lindgren for Hour 1 of Episode 687 to examine the strange textual history behind Revelation, the formation of the New Testament, and the deeper psychological consequences of apocalyptic belief.


We look closely at Desiderius Erasmus and the creation of the printed Greek New Testament that became associated with the Textus Receptus, including the medieval manuscript used for Revelation, the missing final verses that Erasmus reconstructed through Latin, and the famous controversy surrounding 1 John 5:7.


From there, the conversation expands into a larger question: how certain can we really be about the provenance, dating, authorship, and transmission of texts treated as ancient and authoritative?


Remote Biofield Tuning sessions with Chance are available via Zoom. Learn more and book at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/biofield-tuning


Full archives, extended episodes, and member community at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/plus


SUPPORT INNERVERSE WITH AFFILIATES

Kyle Denton's Potent Plant Medicines – Tippecanoe Herbs (use coupon code 'innerverse'): https://www.tippecanoeherbs.com

The World’s Best Tuning Fork: https://biofieldtuningstore.com/collections/the-sonic-slider-collection?ref=innerverse

Flower Elixirs by LotusWei: https://www.lotuswei.com/innerverse


We also explore:

• Erasmus and the standardization of the Greek New Testament

• Minuscule 2814 and the ending of the Book of Revelation

• The disputed “three are one” passage in 1 John 5:7

• Manuscript forgery and the manufacture of ancient authority

• Athanasius, apocryphal books, and the formation of the biblical canon

• The psychological effects of end-times and rapture programming

• Astrotheology and the possibility of scripture encoded through the heavens

• Mazzaroth, the zodiac, Orion, the Pleiades, and the biblical sky clock

• Lucifer as the Morning Star and the symbolism of Venus

• Why “apocalypse” originally means an unveiling


The point is not to replace one dogma with another. It is to investigate the chain of custody, question inherited assumptions, and recover the symbolic, mystical, and initiatory dimensions that literalism can obscure.


Originally featured on CRROW777 Radio, Episode 687.

item.itunes:title: Tartaria and the 1893 World's Fair: Debunking the Conspiracy Claims with Historical Records
item.itunes:subtitle: A Forensic Debunk of Exposing the Expositions
item.description:
The 1893 Chicago World's Fair is a cornerstone of the Tartaria and mudflood theory: the claim that its Greco-Roman buildings were dug out of a buried advanced civilization and passed off as new. I believed it believed it for years, until I looked at the historical records and 700 archival photos.


Video Episode: https://youtu.be/yDjbnjjona0


Chance and Dylan dig into the 1893 Chicago World's Columbian Exposition, the cornerstone of the Tartaria and mudflood theory that an advanced lost civilization built the "White City" and that elites faked its construction. Using C.D. Arnold's 700-photo construction archive, period engineering journals, and a frame-by-frame forensic analysis of the so-called impossible photos, this Inner Whirled investigation walks through how the fair was really built with staff plaster, timber, and 40,000 workers, why the "no blueprints" and "no materials" claims collapse on contact with the archive, and what this means for Tartaria.

As a working Biofield Tuning practitioner, Chance questions whether anyone can truly write to the human biofield, drawing the line between the materialist science of bioelectricity and the consciousness that actually forms the field.

item.itunes:title: The Golden Orphism Book: Is It Real? A Forensic Analysis of the "Oldest Book In The World"
item.itunes:subtitle: Oldest Book, or Modern Fake?
item.description:
The Golden Orphic Book, is alleged to be the "oldest book in the world." This six-page Etruscan gold codex dated to 600 BC is almost certainly a forgery, and the story of how it was sold to the public is a masterclass in how corrupt archaeology and the dead internet manufactures false history, one Facebook-sourced search result at a time.

In this episode we do a complete forensic breakdown of the Golden Etruscan Book, and the reasons the Etruscan language cannot truly be translated. This episode will give you the tools to spot ancient artifact forgery, including a transliteration of the text in the Plus+ Extension.

item.title: The Real Atlantis: Fall of the Pole Star & World Cataclysms | Jason Quitt on The Shining Island
item.itunes:title: The Real Atlantis: Fall of the Pole Star & World Cataclysms | Jason Quitt on The Shining Island
item.itunes:subtitle: Jason Quitt unveils how the fall of the Pole Star in 9,600 BCE matches the "destruction" of the lost city.
item.description:
Discover the real Atlantis in this deep dive into Plato's Timaeus and Critias. Jason Quitt unveils how the fall of the Pole Star in 9,600 BCE matches the "destruction" of the lost city.


Video Episode: https://youtu.be/qahzHZ5JG_o


For thousands of years people have searched for the lost city of Atlantis, scouring the ocean floor and the far corners of the earth for a sunken continent, but what if Atlantis was never a place at all? In this episode, returning guest Jason Quitt joins Chance to unveil the central thesis of his brand new book, The Shining Island, in the very first long-form conversation recorded about it. Together they walk through Plato's two Atlantis dialogues, the Timaeus and the Critias, and make the case that the entire story is a celestial allegory, a creation myth written in the stars. The destruction of Atlantis, dated by Plato to 9,600 BCE, lines up with a moment when there was no pole star to guide humanity. This is a deep, dense, and genuinely mind-expanding conversation about the oldest story ever told, the story of the stars.

item.title: Why Herodotus Never Mentioned Rome | Inner Whirled Episode 1
item.itunes:title: Why Herodotus Never Mentioned Rome | Inner Whirled Episode 1
item.itunes:subtitle: Why Herodotus never mentioned Rome, the Etruscan origins of the West, and the real universal empire of ancient Italy.
item.description:
The Real Universal Empire by Dylan Saccoccio traces the origins of Western civilization, written language, and ancient priestcraft back to the seafaring Etruscan culture of pre-Roman Italy rather than to Greece, India, or the Levant. This is the first episode of Inner Whirled, a co-hosted deep-dive series on the book and the research behind it.


Topics include the Sanskrit and Indo-European origin debate, the oldest evidence of ancient alphabets and why letter count alone exposes the accepted timeline, the cultural affinity between the Etruscans and the Egyptians, why neither Herodotus nor Thucydides ever wrote about Rome, and the strange absence of ancient Italy from mainstream historical writing.


This is a remastered episode originally published March 7th 2024.

Watch the video version: https://youtu.be/4SOh3qBLkBY

item.title: The Wheel, the Bull, and the Chariot That Doesn’t Move | Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies)
item.itunes:title: The Wheel, the Bull, and the Chariot That Doesn’t Move | Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies)
item.itunes:subtitle: The wheel, the bull, and the metaphysics of cosmic flow
item.description:
The Dharma wheel. The Christian cross. The Egyptian bull god. Symbolic researcher Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies returns to InnerVerse for a freeform exploration of a central metaphysical pattern, questioning if that pattern may be the architecture of reality itself.


Watch the video episode


Why does the Rider-Waite Chariot card show wheels pointed sideways and sphinxes that aren’t even harnessed? What does the bull have in common with the cross? Why did nearly every ancient culture place a bull, a tree, or a still point at the center of its cosmology? And what does any of this mean for the spiritual journey in an age of accelerating modernity?


Topics traced: the unmoved mover, the still center versus the spinning circumference, bull symbolism across Vedic, Buddhist, Egyptian, Greek, and Phoenician traditions, the philological golden thread connecting wheels, bulls, bills, and lords, René Guénon’s reign of quantity, and why “going with the flow” is centripetal physics in metaphysical disguise.


Get InnerVerse Plus+ for the Extended Episode - https://www.innerverseplus.com

Patreon | Substack | Youtube


The extended conversation follows the wheel and bull symbolism thread into the modern world, tracing the reign of quantity, the acceleration of time, and what ancient metaphysics has to say about the age of AI and digital consciousness. The philological golden thread continues throughout, drawing unexpected connections across language, religion, and the hidden architecture of power that runs from antiquity to the present day.

item.title: The Empire of Baal Part 2: The Celts, Beltane & the Phoenician Connection | Inner Whirled Ep. 21
item.itunes:title: The Empire of Baal Part 2: The Celts, Beltane & the Phoenician Connection | Inner Whirled Ep. 21
item.itunes:subtitle: Every Day You're Paying Baal
item.description:
THE EMPIRE OF BAAL continues. This episode follows the golden thread westward into Celtic Europe, tracing the bull god's fingerprints across Ireland and Britain.


Watch the Video of this Episode | Watch Part 1 first | Inner Whirled (All Episodes)


What do Celtic mythology, Beltane, and the ancient Phoenicians have in common? In Part 2 of The Empire of Baal, Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio follow the linguistic and ritual signature of the bull god Baal across the ancient world — from the Mediterranean into Gaul, Britain, and Ireland — tracing a continuous system of ancient religion preserved across thousands of years and thousands of miles.


Topics include the Celtic god Belenus and his philological identity with Dionysus, the shared origin of Beltane, Walpurgisnacht, and Ash Wednesday as fire festivals, the linguistic parallel between ancient Phoenician and Irish, the etymology of Pharaoh, pyramid, and Baal, the bull and Taurus symbolism throughout the Old Testament, and the gods Adonis, Bacchus, and Mithras as regional expressions of one ancient system.

item.title: Liev Dalton | Beyond Germ Theory: Terrain Medicine, Trauma & the Healing Trap
item.itunes:title: Liev Dalton | Beyond Germ Theory: Terrain Medicine, Trauma & the Healing Trap
item.itunes:subtitle: What's the Difference Between Healing and Being Healed?
item.description:
Liev Dalton of Beyond Terrain joins InnerVerse to challenge germ theory, trauma dogma, symptom suppression, supplements, protocols, and the deeper healing trap hidden inside both mainstream and alternative medicine.


This conversation teaches terrain health, exposes fear-based stories that keep people stuck, and why true healing begins with spiritual wholeness.

Liev’s background in biochemistry, molecular biology, microbiology, virology, and counseling psychology gives him a unique perspective on the dogmas of both mainstream medicine and alternative healing culture. After years of working as a therapist and exploring psychosomatic modalities, Liev came to a difficult realization: many people were not being set free by endlessly focusing on their trauma, symptoms, diagnoses, supplements, and protocols. In many cases, the healing process itself had become another identity trap.


The first hour gets into the philosophy of terrain medicine, the limitations of germ theory, finishing with “trauma healing” for good, Liev’s departure from the regulated therapy world, and the deeper spiritual question of what it means to become whole rather than endlessly “work on” being healed.


Support the podcast, double your content.

Become an InnerVerse Plus+ member on Patreon, Substack, or Youtube.

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/156869990

Substack: https://innerversepodcast.substack.com/p/beyond-germ-theory-terrain-medicine

Youtube: https://youtu.be/weVoZjFY6Cg


In the Plus+ extension, the conversation gets even more contrarian as Liev turns the parasite panic upside down, questioning ivermectin, deworming, parasite cleanses, supplement protocols, and the whole “kill the hidden enemy” mindset. Are parasites really the cause of disease, or are they part of the body’s attempt to remediate a problem?

item.title: Mary In the Old Testament, Virgo at the Red Sea, & Rev. Taylor's Persecution
item.itunes:title: Mary In the Old Testament, Virgo at the Red Sea, & Rev. Taylor's Persecution
item.itunes:subtitle: Does the Virgin Mary represent Virgo?
item.description:
In Episode 20 of Inner Whirled, we take on one of the least known revelations of biblical astro-theology: that Miriam of Exodus and Mary of the New Testament are the same archetypal character, proven by celestial symbolism and linguistic forensics.


Video Episode: https://youtu.be/0MeHpK8N85s


Drawing on the work of Reverend Robert Taylor, we once again demonstrate how biblical narratives function as astronomical allegories, disproving their historicity, and we show how those who taught this in prior centuries were persecuted.


🔓 Support the research, double your content. Become an InnerVerse Plus+ member.

Patreon | Substack | Youtube


Part 1 lays the foundation: connecting Miriam to the Virgo archetype, Venus symbolism, and the recurring “goddess of the sea” motif embedded in names like Maria, Miriam, and mare. Through philology and pattern recognition, we examine how the Exodus story—especially the Red Sea crossing—reflects celestial movements rather than historical events.


We’ll teach you about:

  • Miriam = Mary: symbolic and linguistic connections
  • Virgo and Venus as the “Divine Feminine” archetype
  • The Red Sea as astronomical allegory
  • Reverend Robert Taylor and persecution for astro-theology
  • Allegory vs literal history in the Bible
  • Media, control, and the shaping of belief systems


🔒 In Part 2 we move from connection into code, further demonstrating the symbolism of the celestial ocean. The Exodus account unfolds as a sky map where Virgo, Venus, and the Red Sea aren’t metaphors, but coordinates.From the rising and falling of constellations to the strange language of “persecution” as celestial following, we trace how these stories map a system far older than scripture.

item.title: Training Kids To See While Blindfolded with Edith Ubuntu Chan
item.itunes:title: Training Kids To See While Blindfolded with Edith Ubuntu Chan
item.itunes:subtitle: Kids are learning to see while blindfolded, and it’s not a magic trick.
item.description:
In this conversation with Dr. Edith Ubuntu Chan, we explore blindfold vision, intuitive perception, and what happens when children are trained to trust their natural awareness instead of overriding it.

This isn’t about party tricks or “superpowers,” it’s about restoring a baseline human capacity to know right from wrong.

We get into how these abilities emerge, why they feel effortless when they’re working, and how overthinking blocks perception. Edith shares how she’s worked with families and children to develop these skills, and what it reveals about consciousness, education, and the future of human potential.

If you’ve ever had moments of intuition that felt beyond your senses, or believe consciousness extends beyond the physical body, this conversation will resonate.


🧠 Topics include:

• Blindfold vision and how it’s taught

• Why kids learn this faster than adults

• The role of flow state vs overthinking

• Intuition as a trainable skill

• Consciousness beyond the five senses

• A new model of learning and human development


In Part 2 we discuss the importance of departing from models (conventional and alternative) of childhood education, the incredible psychic abilities of undamaged children, and how personal energy mastery invokes consistent synchronicity.

item.title: THE EMPIRE OF BA'AL | Inner Whirled Ep. 19
item.itunes:title: THE EMPIRE OF BA'AL | Inner Whirled Ep. 19
item.itunes:subtitle: Heavy Is The Head That Wears The Triple Crown
item.description:
The name Ba’al is feared by Abrahamic religious types, and that aversion has concealed a linguistic key that connects systems of power, priesthood, and rulership across time and history, worldwide.


Video Episode: https://youtu.be/h3oTnjSC2Uc


🔓 Support the research, double your content. Become an InnerVerse Plus+ member.

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/155207722

Substack: https://innerversepodcast.substack.com/p/the-empire-of-baal-dad

Youtube:https://youtu.be/WDupc5FXEXk


In this episode of Inner Whirled, we trace the name Ba’al through languages, mythologies, and historical systems, revealing how a single root appears everywhere: Baal, Bel, Bol, Vul, El, Allah, Adonai, Jupiter, Adonis…


From ancient temples and pyramidal structures to the gilded cage of modern feudalism, we demonstrate how Ba’al reveals the blackest form of magic practiced by the ruling classes of all ages… not an obscure Old Testament character, a universal pattern of authority, embedded in language, religion, and society itself.


We’ll teach you about:

  • The “double doctrine” — exoteric vs esoteric truth
  • How truth is concealed by atrocity propaganda and frightening characters like Ba’al
  • The connection between Ba’al, “Lord,” and ruling hierarchies
  • How to spot philological links across cultures (BOL / BL / VL roots)
  • Mount Meru, pyramids, and the symbolic structure of the globalism
  • Triple Crown of Ba’al: Medieval Papal Bulls & Modern Middle Eastern Wars


🔒 In Part 2 we move from symbolism into structure. Ba’al begins to appear not just as a god, but as Dharma, justice, and law itself… embodied in the bull that upholds cosmic order. How does that symbol translate into priesthoods, papal power, and the systems that claim authority over all humanity?

From the Triple Crown of Ba’al to papal bulls and modern banking, we trace a continuous pattern where religion, law, and debt converge into one system.

If currency is debt, and debt is ownership… are we participants in the system, or its property?

item.title: Rivers of the Sun, Rivers of Blood (Moses, Christ & the Hidden System) | Inner Whirled ep. 18
item.itunes:title: Rivers of the Sun, Rivers of Blood (Moses, Christ & the Hidden System) | Inner Whirled ep. 18
item.itunes:subtitle: The geopolitical ramifications of scriptural literalism...
item.description:
What if everyone knew that religion was never about real people, but symbolized natural forces? The geopolitical ramifications of scriptural literalism have never been more evident, as our analysis of Aaron Exodus, and the Golden Calf demonstrates.


VIDEO EPISODE: https://youtu.be/bLQCXOUMZRo


In this episode of Inner Whirled, we take another swing at exposing the symbolic framework behind mythology that masquerades as history. Drawing on the work of Rev. Robert Taylor and our own research, we demonstrate how figures like Moses and Jesus represent natural, celestial, and hydrological forces, especially the relationship between the sun and water.


From the "blood of the river" to modern baptism, we show how greased up priests and their anointing oils have misconstrued metaphors for millennia, turning real world wisdom into superstitious belief systems.


🔒 In Part 2 we enter rarely explored territory of the uncomfortable connection between the golden calf, money, kingship, and a system of symbols that still plasters power structures today. Moses may be linguistically connected to the calf? Where does Taurus show up in coinage, cathedrals, and scripture? And the biggest question: was history itself constructed from this same symbolic system in the relatively recent past?

item.title: The Nuclear Bomb Hoax with Brandon Thomas (Mysterious Universe) and Tamara Sheville
item.itunes:title: The Nuclear Bomb Hoax with Brandon Thomas (Mysterious Universe) and Tamara Sheville
item.itunes:subtitle: Are nuclear weapons actually real?
item.description:
Joining InnerVerse for their first time, Tamara Sheville and Brandon Thomas are here to explore one of the most absurd deceptions in the history of psyops.


Drawing from Tamara's background in hazardous materials, DoJ training programs and real-world chemical, biological and radiation hazard response team work, Tamara is primed to deliver a powerful truth bomb about the science of nuclear fission, why it works for power plants but will never go boom, and how the evidence from Japan's supposedly nuked cities tells a different story to the trained eye.


As the co-host of the new Mysterious Universe podcast, Brandon Thomas is no stranger to fringe ideas, bringing his jovial yet razor sharp spiritual discernment to bear on the devilish details of this conspiracy.


🔓 UNLOCK THE FULL EPISODE

Patreon | Substack | Youtube


For the members we answer all the questions left on the table:

+ Mechanics of nuclear fission and why it can’t produce an explosion

+ The “nuclear shadows” phenomenon and why it raises serious questions

+ Underwater tests, mushroom clouds, and what actually creates those visuals

+ Additional historical inconsistencies that don’t line up with the official story

item.title: Why Would the "Right" Cancel Plato? Chance Garton on Dawn of Discernment | Ep. 25: Balance is Key
item.itunes:title: Why Would the "Right" Cancel Plato? Chance Garton on Dawn of Discernment | Ep. 25: Balance is Key
item.description:
I recently joined Dawn Lester, co-author of "What Really Makes You Ill," for an engaging and highly philosophical exploration of the schismatical schematic underlying the "right, left, right, left" march of tyranny's boots. This was inspired by the recent banning of Plato by a Texas university, and the consideration of what we can learn from Plato's esoteric teachings.


From Dawn's episode description:

In our conversation Chance and I discuss many topics, including how systems of all kinds, especially the political system, swing from one extreme to another and how neither ‘extreme’ is able to actually find solutions. These swings are a pattern we need to recognise to better understand what may be happening in our own lives to bring it back into balance. Chance also talks about biofield tuning and how imbalances show up in our biofield.

Join us for a fascinating conversation and a deep dive into understanding why it’s important to recognise these patterns and discern our way out of ideas imposed on us and into a more harmonious flow through life.

item.title: Who Was Moses? Decoding the Ark, the River, and the Astro-Theology of the Bible's Lawgiver
item.itunes:title: Who Was Moses? Decoding the Ark, the River, and the Astro-Theology of the Bible's Lawgiver
item.description:
Moses is one of the most foundational figures in the Old Testament — the deliverer of the Israelites, the lawgiver of the Pentateuch, the prophet who climbed Mount Sinai. The symbolism around him has been studied for centuries, and there are layers most modern readers never encounter.


In this episode, Chance and co-host Dylan Saccoccio return from hiatus with a fresh look at Moses, building on the research of Reverend Robert Taylor and tracing the threads through Josephus, Philo, Higgins, and the wider ancient world.


In this session: the meaning of the name Moses and its possible Egyptian and Greek roots, the symbolism of the infant placed in a basket on the river, the Ark motif across world mythologies, the etymology connecting Moses to water, rivers, and the muses, the parallels between Moses and Bacchus, Oceanus as the primal waters encircling creation, and the early church writings that connect these layers.


Remote Biofield Tuning sessions with Chance are available via Zoom. Learn more and book at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/biofield-tuning


Full archives, extended episodes, and member community at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/plus

In this collaborative exploration, researcher and cipher analyst Michael Anthony Alberta joins InnerVerse for a wide-ranging exposé on the fabrication of historical memory. Drawing from Alberta’s book Encrypted Reality and paired with deep thematic analysis, this episode presents a compelling case that many of our oldest civilizations — and the timelines that support them — were forged during the Renaissance to support theological, political, and astronomical agendas.


Topics include Fomenko’s New Chronology, repeated dynasties, astrotheological overlays, forged documents, and the priesthood’s role in designing history as we know it. This is not a conventional interview, but a layered presentation of paradigm-shifting ideas, decoding the hidden architecture behind our inherited sense of time.

item.itunes:title: Cosmic Secrets: Antarctica, the Sun, and the Ultimate Cover-Up with Steve Falconer
item.itunes:subtitle: What's hiding at the edge of the world?
item.description:
In this reality-rattling episode, Steve Falconer of Spacebusters joins InnerVerse to challenge the official story of Antarctica — and with it, the entire cosmological structure we’ve been taught to trust.


We break down:

  • ❄️ The “Final Experiment” video and its deception
  • 🔦 Why sun observations at Antarctic bases don’t match any globe model
  • 📜 Zetetic science vs. Newtonian illusion
  • 🗺️ The mystery of maps, magnetic anomalies, and missing circumnavigations
  • 🧠 How spiritual sovereignty connects to cosmic awareness


Steve peels back layers of illusion — geographic, scientific, and metaphysical — to reveal a world far stranger and more sacred than we’ve been led to believe. Whether you're globe-weary or just hungry for deeper knowing, this episode is a metaphysical expedition you won’t forget.


🎧 PLUS+ members get the second hour, where we dive into:

→ Parabolic sun illusions and toroidal light fields

→ The deeper meaning of the Antarctic “theater”

→ Why the map is wrong, the sun is local, and the realm is electric

→ And much more!

Marty Leeds (Gnostic Academy) and Steven Young (Hedflux) have something in common: they're both fascinated and inspired by the 16th-17th century Alchemist, Robert Fludd. In this episode, we explore the natural philosophy, musical cosmology, and metaphysics and divine sciences of one of history's greatest minds. Some topics include the infinite and indivisible God, Jesus: the light of the mind, Fludd's beef with Johannes Kepler, and the History of the Macrocosm.

item.description:
InnerVerse champion Slick Dissident returns for a discussion about the core dialectic of philosophy: theory and praxis. We discuss the relationship of the archetypal enneagram to social engineering, the secret nature of higher knowledge, the virtuality of virtue, comparative rhetoric and direct vs. esoteric communication, analytic continental philosophy, the hermetic law of half-truths, and Thucydides' Trap.

 

In the Plus+ Extension we ponder whether the philosopher is a fundamentally different sort of human being, Plato's Republic and the ultimate "bad job" of the utopian state, how esotericism insulates reason from politics, the anti-tragic progressive humanism that Western society is built on, Mercurial "poiesis" as the balance between theory and praxis, and the modern "noble lie" that is social justice. All that and much more!

item.itunes:title: Mark Gober | An End to the Upside Down Cosmos: Space Agency Frauds, Physics Fakery, & Flat Earth
item.itunes:subtitle: Space: The Crown Jewel of Clown World Cosmology...
item.description:
Mark Gober returns to InnerVerse to discuss his newest book, An End to the Upside Down Cosmos. With his usual impeccable and comprehensive research style, Gober's 7th book is the best and most challenging yet--rethinking the foundational theories of modern physics, and most importantly, the nature of our world itself. We discuss how cosmology fits in to the scientific Tower of Babel, tackle the lack of images of Earth from alleged outer space, question space agency frauds and the moon landing hoax, dissect the problems with dark matter, dark energy, gravity, special relativity, and more…

 

In the Plus+ Extension you'll learn about the heliocentrism and the Copernican principle, that "the science" can't stand the idea that Earth is special, do-it-your-self observations that refute the globe hypothesis, magnetic declination and other southern hemisphere anomalies, all while peppering in philosophical considerations about the deceptive nature of evil, the nature of consciousness, and geocentric astrology.

"Take a break with me as we chat with Chance Garton. If you are feeling down or are needing a break from what appears to be a very dark landscape, this is the chat for you.


Chance and I get into the power of healing through tuning forks, mindful curation of thought and perception bias, and then we move into the ever fascinating realm of language -- dead languages and the power of words as they relate to the mutable modern world of communication that includes emojis, slang, and ebonics. item.description:
Mike Wilkerson of Stellium7 on Youtube joins InnerVerse to discuss his research on Bio-Geology and the ways in which organic material becomes petrified. Is the earth below our feet made from the remains of ancient mega-fauna? What does the mainstream say about the possibility that aside from igneous stone, all rock was once alive? We discuss all of this and more, including theories about the shrinking of life forms over eons, ubiquitous fractal patterns, & sonoluminescence.

 

In the Plus+ Extension we talk about the infamous Montgo titanic elephant, more fascinating petrification possibilities, histology of geological materials, biological transmutations unrecognized by "the science," unanswered questions about Mike's Titan, the evidence for super-massive petrified trees, heart-stones, research synchronicities, and the panpsychism of stone.

item.itunes:title: Jack Kelley | The Solution to the Atlantis Puzzle: Cosmogony, World Ages & Plato's Secret Teachings
item.itunes:subtitle: Filtering Plato's Fact, Fiction, & Philosophy...
item.description:
Jack Kelley is a lifelong student of the ancient philosophers and the director of a new documentary called The Atlantis Puzzle. In his film, Jack searches for answers about the fabled Atlantis by reviewing just what Plato said about the lost city in conjunction with modern geology and archeology. We discuss the contents of Plato's Timaeus, the problems with pop culture Atlantis stories, the Platonic contemplation of a perfect society, and his co-star George Sarantitis' Methodology of Mythology.

 

In the Plus+ Extension we go deeper into the possible locations for Atlantis, the importance of specific syntax with ancient authors, the mysterious Richat Structure of Mauritania, questions about our current quality of life vs. the ancient world, a profound examination of Platonic philosophy, the value of the cosmological monomyth, the how and why of esoteric and exoteric teachings, the secret identity of Homer, and much more.

item.title: Robert Falconer: Spirit Possession in Therapy, Internal Family Systems and the Others Within Us
item.itunes:title: Robert Falconer: Spirit Possession in Therapy, Internal Family Systems and the Others Within Us
item.itunes:subtitle: Meet The Cast of Your Inner World...
item.description:
Robert Falconer is a senior teacher in Internal Family Systems (IFS), one of the most influential modern psychotherapy modalities, and the author of The Others Within Us — a clinical exploration of the psyche as a system of parts, and what happens when something inside the mind isn't actually part of the person at all.


In this conversation: how IFS understands the mind as a multiplicity of parts rather than a single self, the difference between managers, firefighters, and exiles, the discovery of Self with a capital S and why it's never damaged regardless of trauma, what Richard Schwartz figured out by working with eating disorder patients, the science of legacy burdens and generational trauma (including the famous Diaz wrestler experiment with rats), and what Bob calls unattached burdens — entities that present clinically but don't seem to belong to the person at all.


Remote Biofield Tuning sessions with Chance are available via Zoom. Learn more and book at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/biofield-tuning


Full archives, extended episodes, and member community at https://www.innerversepodcast.com/plus

https://www.innerversepodcast.com/plus/robert-falconer-ifs

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/robert-falconer-105485488

Substack: https://innerversepodcast.substack.com/p/robert-falconer-spirit-possession

Youtube: https://youtu.be/V3b01XTnMS0

item.title: Ray Catania | The Atheist and the Afterlife: N.D.E., Mediumship & Managing Psychic Abilities
item.itunes:title: Ray Catania | The Atheist and the Afterlife: N.D.E., Mediumship & Managing Psychic Abilities
item.itunes:subtitle: Accessing the Afterlife...
item.description:
Ray Catania joins InnerVerse to discuss his book The Atheist and the Afterlife, an autobiography about his early life Near Death Experience and the psychic abilities that it unlocked. In this episode he retells this story, including things like life-saving spirit guides, the uncomfortable awakening to mediumship, receiving verifiable information from deceased people, the synchronistic discovery of mentors, and Ray's theories on the grand questions of our existence.

 

In the Plus+ Extension, Ray validates some of my own mediumship experiences, we riff about spirit attachments, breaking the cycle of recurring negative patterns, the deprogramming of unhelpful unconscious beliefs, how contact with the beyond puts mundane problems into a bigger perspective, Ray's meetings with a Jesus-like being, and Ray's advice on how to learn the frequency language of one's ethereal guides.

item.title: Christopher McIntosh | Return of the Tetrad: Occult Forces, Magical Objects & The Cosmic Joke
item.itunes:title: Christopher McIntosh | Return of the Tetrad: Occult Forces, Magical Objects & The Cosmic Joke
item.itunes:subtitle: Living 'As If' Anything Is Possible...
item.description:
Dr. Christopher McIntosh returns to InnerVerse to discuss the fascinating and fantastic ideas that are allegorized in his novel, Return of the Tetrad. Some things we explore include the inspirations for this tale and how it relates to his own spiritual journey, magic as a way of seeing the world, black magic and dark occult forces, the Mercurial trickster and devil, ritual replacement of a human psyche with demonic entities, and the cosmic giggle of mystical synchronicity.

 

In the Plus+ Extension, we talk about roles of the sexes in magical lifestyles, the process of occult initiations and the four elements, the Brotherhood of Light, transcendental awareness, the Rosicrucian great game, magical objects, the Prognometer, fate vs. free will, the European mythos of the hairy wild man, and what magical research was like in the pre-internet era. All that and much more!

item.title: The Fallout of Historical Forgery | Preview of Inner Whirled Ep. 4 (Dylan Saccoccio & Chance Garton)
item.itunes:title: The Fallout of Historical Forgery | Preview of Inner Whirled Ep. 4 (Dylan Saccoccio & Chance Garton)
item.itunes:subtitle: How Much of "History" is Fake?
item.description:
Welcome to Inner Whirled, the new podcast with Dylan Saccoccio and Chance Garton, where we'll be providing deeply researched and well prepared podcasts on Spirit Whirled subjects, the language, symbolism, artifacts and system of the ancient universal priestcraft, all reserved exclusively for our direct supporters.

 

Episode 4 investigates the widespread prevalence of literary fraud amongst Renaissance Italian humanists, such as Poggio Bracciolini and Petrarch. What would it mean for our view of history, if forgery was the rule, rather than exception, when it comes to the literature of Roman and Greek antiquity? What motivated the fad of fabricating archaic manuscripts? And what does it tell us about the foundations of other institutional paradigms in our modern world, if deception can go unchecked and unrecognized?

item.itunes:title: Michelle Lundquist | Holistic Herbal Wisdom & Creating a Healing Home For Our Beloved Animals
item.itunes:subtitle: Fortifying Our Four-Legged Friends...
item.description:
The mighty Michelle Lundquist of the Healing Home podcast joins InnerVerse for a heartfelt chat about taking care of cats. In this episode we discuss her initiation on the path of the herbal naturalist because of her cat's special needs, along with advice about veterinary involvement for pets, tea-time for kitties, learning your pet's story and speaking their language, recognizing the six tissue states as categories of bodily communication, flower essences, homeopathy, navigating healing crisis, and much more. These things apply to more than just cats, so tune in for a playful romp with the four legged beings closest to our hearts.

 

In the Plus+ Extension we contemplate the mirroring between ourselves and our pets, probiotics and digestive aids, the use of comfrey, the rhythm of medicinal administration, natural remedies for fleas and ticks, the do's and don'ts with plants and oils for pets, mushrooms, CBD, and nutritional quality considerations. This extension is packed with timeless wisdom, and it's a lot of fun.

item.description:
Tonight we are going to take a look at the origins and progress of religious idolatry, using the Serpent of Genesis and its symbolic meaning as our primary example. None can dispute the universality of serpent iconography in the ancient world, but what did it mean, and how was that meaning lost amidst the ever growing catalogue of icons and idols that emerged through the ages? We may see a surprise special guest or two tonight!

item.title: Dr. John Knight Lundwall | Wisdom & The Oral Tradition: Memory and Storytelling From Mythos to Logos
item.itunes:title: Dr. John Knight Lundwall | Wisdom & The Oral Tradition: Memory and Storytelling From Mythos to Logos
item.itunes:subtitle: Observing The Original Oral Aura...
item.description:
Dr. John Knight Lundwall joins InnerVerse to discuss his groundbreaking book, Mythos and Cosmos: Mind and Meaning in the Oral Age. Picking up the torch where hundreds of years of academia missed the mark, Dr. Lundwall guides our understanding of mythology as a technical language akin to scientific jargon, exposes the epistemological wall between literacy and orality, explains the analogical aspect of oral myth via the example of human sacrifices, and ponders why oral cultures did not keep histories as we know them.

 

In the Plus+ Extension we turn our discussion towards the category error of modernity to consider oral rites and stories as religion, question just what religion is through the example of the cult of state mandated "public health," the Renaissance prodigy Camillo and what his memory theater informs us of our own potential to recall complex ideas, the relationship between light pollution and literacy, and what it means to marry the best of both the oral and literary mind.

 

Support InnerVerse Rokfin and Patreon for extended episodes!

  • https://www.patreon.com/posts/96545676

item.title: Gregory Ripley | Hundred Remedies of the Tao: Mystic Taoism, Stellar Ritual, & the Wu Wei Flow
item.itunes:title: Gregory Ripley | Hundred Remedies of the Tao: Mystic Taoism, Stellar Ritual, & the Wu Wei Flow
item.itunes:subtitle: Emanations of the Ineffable...
item.description:
Gregory Ripley is a Taoist Priest in the Quanzhen Longmen tradition, and a Forest Therapy Guide. In this episode we discuss his brand new book, One Hundred Remedies of the Tao: Spiritual Wisdom for Interesting Times. Throughout this conversation we discuss Wu Wei and achieving "the zone" flow states, how philosophy acts as medicine, syncretism between the mystery schools of ancient far east and Occident, the role of luminaries and the pole star in Taoism, and much more.

 

In the Plus+ Extension, we investigate the relationship of the living to their ancestors, the primordial being Pangu, dynastic cycles as world age revolutions, the emperor as sacred center, eclipses and the saving of the sun ritual, Mercury and internal alchemy, and how to keep hold of our spiritual epiphanies in times of dissonance.

item.title: John McHugh | Maps of Human Consciousness: Southwest American Rock Art Through the Ages
item.itunes:title: John McHugh | Maps of Human Consciousness: Southwest American Rock Art Through the Ages
item.itunes:subtitle: Their Rock Is Not As Our Rock...
item.description:
The brilliant archeoastronomy analyst John McHugh returns to InnerVerse to share his field work and research on the ancient cultures of the American Southwest. In this video presentation John presents a comprehensive catalogue of petroglyphs and rock art through the ages and a crash course in the academic understanding of their cultural chronology. Dancing with live snakes? Check. Symbolic signatures of the universal monomyth and its archetypes? Got that too! Tune in for a shamanic synthesis of John's many years of investigation.

 

In the Plus+ Extension, we continue John's presentation, with artifacts and evidence of thunder rattles, face scalping, decapitated maize gods, kachina spirits, and a summary roundup of what all these strange and fascinating relics might mean about human nature and our deep past.

item.description:
Comedian Owen Benjamin joins Chance and mystical bodyworker Topher Gardner for a wide-ranging conversation right after Owen's first comedy special in four years and just days after the October 2023 eclipse. Three different lenses on the same big shift happening in human consciousness right now.


In this session: Owen's return to standup and what it took to keep going through four years of being de-platformed, the noble savage as the archetype of someone who lives by their own values rather than the trader's script, the thinking class versus the doing class versus the trader class, the symbolism of the eclipse and the alignment of cultural events around it, manifesting reality through collective focus, energy work and what it really means to project consciousness, the Plato Symposium and the deeper meaning behind ancient ritual roles, and Topher's framework of Biocharisma.

item.title: ShaOne & Slick | The Seven Scales of Creation: Universal Harmonic Patterns In Musical Modes
item.itunes:title: ShaOne & Slick | The Seven Scales of Creation: Universal Harmonic Patterns In Musical Modes
item.itunes:subtitle: Life's A Jam Session, So Get In Tune...
item.description:
In this epic episode, I'm joined by lifelong musician and InnerVersal acolyte, Sean Clarke, aka shaOne. Along for the ride is our favorite syncromystic sensei, Slick Dissident, as the three of us embark on an incredible esoteric exploration of the seven modes of music: Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian, and Locrian. To emphasize the character of each mode, Sean came equipped with his celestial Multiac guitar to improvise scales and riffs in each. Sit back and close your eyes for this auditory journey, and feel into the personality signature of each sonic touchstone!

 

In the 2 hour Plus+ Extension, we continue with the modes we didn't get to in part one, and begin fleshing out the deeper pattern contained in this mystery, that reveals the created nature of this realm and the fractal micro/macrocosm contained within musical science. This unique and inspired episode is not one to miss!

item.title: Hakan Hisim | Translating Xenoglossolalia: The Psychedelic Tricksters & Spiritual Liberation
item.itunes:title: Hakan Hisim | Translating Xenoglossolalia: The Psychedelic Tricksters & Spiritual Liberation
item.itunes:subtitle: Deciphering The Codes of Reality...
item.description:
The great visionary artist Hakan Hisim returns to InnerVerse! In the four years since he last appeared on the show, Hakan has completed a massive magnum opus called The Universal Transmissions Codex, a culmination of his lifelong fascination with xenolinguistics and the strange glyphs and symbols that astral explorers and psychedelic adventurers often report seeing overlaid on our reality. We also discuss the mindsets necessary for making it as a professional artist, as well as the technological language that are our bodies and chakra systems. This one is jam packed with wisdom!

 

In the oversized Plus+ Extension, Hakan shares a deeply personal account of his spiritual dark night of the soul, in which he found himself locked away in a maximum security prison in Turkey with no light at the end of the tunnel. In this tale, Hakan recounts his encounters with tantra teaching dream guides, the experimental psychedelics that turned his life upside down, and the incredible self-realization he achieved while in jail that ultimately transformed his reality and set him free. Easily one of the greatest stories ever told in any podcast, anywhere, so don't miss it.

item.itunes:title: Bernie Taylor | The Primal Hero Before Orion: Cave and Rock Art, & Mankind's Original Mythology
item.itunes:subtitle: Their Rock Is Not As Our Rock...
item.description:
Video - https://youtu.be/54n4bqpFC2s


Naturalist and ArcheoAstronomer, Bernie Taylor, joins InnerVerse to discuss his groundbreaking work, Before Orion: Finding the Face of the Hero. In this discussion, we discover the monomyth in ancient cave wall rock art, search for the identity of the Cosmic Man, consider the magnitude of primal pareidolia, discern tribal customs and laws from cave art, and ponder ancient clues as to the origin of constellations. 

 

In the Plus+ Extension, we discuss biological time as encoded in rock art, the beginnings of animalistic calendrical symbolism, the Atlas mountains as the potential birthplace of astronomy, the reason for caves as the first initiation spaces, the mythical underpinnings of pseudo-scientific cosmology such as the big bang and multiverse, the first written languages, and the Tifinagh script of North Africa.

item.itunes:title: Rachel Fulton Brown | Mystic Christianity, Tolkien's Cosmogony, & The Logos of Created Worlds
item.itunes:subtitle: You can only come to the morning through the shadows...
item.description:
Video - https://youtu.be/7ojAnjMGWvc


Professor Rachel Fulton Brown joins InnerVerse to talk Tolkien! In this lively discussion we explore Tolkien's mytho-mystic Christian convictions as allegorized in his great works, the Lord of the Rings and its massive legendarium. Topics include the Logos, Eros, the Gods & planets, and the purpose of evil and dissonance. What does it mean to be a creator in a created world?

 

In the Plus+ Extension, we examine world mountain and axis mundi symbolism, Earendil and Anglo Saxon literature, strategic philology, the unfinished sequel to the LOTR story, why civilizations fall, and the mystery of cryptid creatures and alternate humanoids of folklore.

item.title: Benjamin Balderson & Rachel Maiden | Norse Morality In Mythology: Odin, The Hávamál, & Poetic Edda
item.itunes:title: Benjamin Balderson & Rachel Maiden | Norse Morality In Mythology: Odin, The Hávamál, & Poetic Edda
item.itunes:subtitle: Wise Words From the High One...
item.description:
Tonight we're joined by Odin's favorite wizard, Benjamin Balderson, and the poetic paganist Rachel Maiden, for an examination of customs and philosophy selected from the Hávamál, and other works of the Poetic Eddas. These two have a great knowledge of Norse Mythology and the morality that it espouses, along with a strong grasp upon the wisdom of the runes, as they've been teaching on the Odin's Alchemy podcast.

 

The Plus+ Extension begins with discussion on the value of difference between regional deities, and by the end we find ourselves in a hilarious set of Odin's observations about the differences between men and women. This is a truly unique second hour, worth the price of admission.

item.itunes:subtitle: Fractal Vessels of Divine Spark…
item.description:
Video: Youtube | Rokfin


Dylan Saccoccio returns to InnerVerse to share the sacred symbolism of the supreme generative power laid up in the mythos of the Ark and the flood hero it bears. Joining us is Mario Garza, to add further observations as we explore the numerous accounts of savior-ships found across countless cultures of all ages, and what hints they may provide to our understanding of an ancient and forgotten universal empire.


Check out my new audiobook narration of Spirit Whirled: A Godsacre For Winds of the Soul, by Dylan Saccoccio - https://tinyurl.com/2p9xpdn3


The over-sized Plus+ Extension (1.5+ hours) is where we really hit our stride, weaving connections between all the disparate hour 1 subjects, and hammering the final nails into that starry coffin that is also a boat, seed, earth, etc...

item.description:
Video - https://youtu.be/gvaRhCK4lRQ


In partnership with Music and Sky, The Way Forward and the InnerVerse Podcast, we are proud to present this fireside chat from the Music and Sky Soul Family Gathering that took place Oct. 13th-16th in Cuyama Valley, CA.


Mike was honored to have one of his favorite podcasters, Chance Garton host a spur-of-the-moment podcast-style chat around the Grand Fire Saturday night with three of our all-time favorites: Kelly Brogan, Alec Zeck and Eileen McKusick. They take on a broad range of topics and ideas about the nature of our realm and the role we play as only they can! This was a very special moment for the gathering and we are very happy to be able to share it with you! Please enjoy and share with your friends and family! We hope to see you at the next Music and Sky!

item.itunes:title: PAT Life Ep. 138 | Tuning Your Biofield With Sound (Chance Garton Interviewed)
item.description:
Had a great chat with PAT Life on the tuning topic!


Description: The vast majority of society experiences and expresses Self within the confines of what we call the material body... Allegedly. But that couldn't be farther from the truth. Our guest today, and I'm honored to call him my friend, is the host of the Innerverse podcast, Chance Garton. Chance has a background in sound healing (for lack of a better term), working with clients from all over the world. Believe it or not, he uses nothing but tuning forks, and maybe a few other modalities, to facilitate the realignment of his client's biofields-- energetic fields, all from the comforts of his home. We dive into all things energy, the human body, the human potential, water, breath, and much more.


Original Post: https://youtu.be/VaXtp2uNC9U

item.title: Worldview Warfare + Synchromysticism 101 | Chance Garton on Word Up! with Dani Katz
item.itunes:title: Worldview Warfare + Synchromysticism 101 | Chance Garton on Word Up! with Dani Katz
item.description:
Dani Katz had me on her excellent podcast, Word Up! Find more Dani Katz here: https://www.danikatz.com


Video of this episode: https://youtu.be/ibF64cNSvZo


The second half of this chat is on her Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/pod-drop-alert-2-69339706 and it's extremely your time! One of the best descriptions of "syncromysticism" I have ever articulated.


Show notes:

  • The body as a vessel of Universal Ether and building a practice that allows us access to this energy through energetic sensitivity and body work
  • The value of energetic attunement
  • Listening to our inner guidance on the path
  • Mapping and tuning the biofield
  • A force by any other name; The role of emotional blockages, stagnated chi, bio-plasma, electricity
  • Our bodies as containers for the universal Aether and the universal cycles of refinement
  • The infinite game of chutes and ladders
  • The material world AS the spirit world
  • Using sound in the quantum field anatomy
  • Serving Sound as a means of countering the inversion and other mystical paradoxes that can be resolved by nonduality
  • A realm of frequency, vibration and story
  • Worldview Warfare: a silent weapon for a silent war on hearts and minds
  • No right to privacy when it come to our connection to the universal Aether
  • Karmic entanglements with the WORD “karma”
  • The consequence of acting out of alignment with natural order
  • The archetype to language pipeline
  • Destiny V Free will: Yes and, please!
  • The alpha numeric crossroads: the erosion of a numerical qualitative order
  • The evolution of story and the paradoxical duality cage of the infinite
  • The omniscopic and other ginormous concepts that evades language
  • The dark and unbalanced dark feminine hysteria and control
  • Removing what it is NOT: apophatic tension
  • Flat Earth Society: Authentic Grassroots organization or installation by three letter alphabet organization?
  • The miraculously unifying elixir of agnosticism and humility
  • The limitation of vocabulary and its relationship to slavery
  • Inverting the living language: How the church and UCC have built an empire using dead language
  • The tinker bell effect: The engineering of belief
  • The syncromystic eye and interpretation of the waking dream
  • The unity of the esoteric and shared exoteric dream
  • Discovering the individualized imaginative and subjective portal of divinely encoded art
  • Syncretism is to harmonization of universal and energetic origins as syncromysticism is to recognize and engage our own interactive consciousness
  • Symbolic Literacy: The power and madness of recognizing the hyperdimensional nature of language and symbols
  • The never-ending web: With great power comes great responsibility

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

item.title: Chance Garton Interviewed on 13 Questions Podcast
item.itunes:title: Chance Garton Interviewed on 13 Questions Podcast
item.description:
Bill and his co-host from 13 Questions Podcast recently had me on to discuss some of life's biggest ponder-worthy questions.


Check it out, if you'd like to hear me do my best to answer the following:

1. What was the best advice ever given to you? Would you modify it all today?

2. What do you choose to ignore?

3. What book has been most influential on your life and why?

4. What rule do you have for yourself that you never break and why do you think that it's important?

5. If I were to ask your best friend what is the one thing they would say you need to work on the

most? Why?

6. What turns you on creatively, spiritually or emotionally?

7. What was the most embarrassing or humbling experience of your life?

8. What is your greatest fear? How did you overcome it?

9. What is your single greatest driving force in life and how do you further it?

10. Who were/are your role models and why?

11. What quality do you most admire in a woman?

12. What is the most courageous thing you have ever done or seen in your life?

13. What does it mean to be a man in today's world?


https://13questions.libsyn.com/090-chance-garton

item.title: Project Chaney Podcast | The Holy Sea with Chance from Innerverse
item.itunes:title: Project Chaney Podcast | The Holy Sea with Chance from Innerverse
item.description:
The great Chaney had me on her podcast for a symbolical romp through the archetypal mythos. Make sure to follow Project Chaney wherever you get podcasts!


Original Post - https://www.buzzsprout.com/1751139/10398011-the-holy-sea-with-chance-from-innerverse


https://projectchaney.com/


EPISODE DESCRIPTION

Are you almost unable to watch anything without wanting to decode it all? Has the fleeting news cycle left you hollow? Do the world's mysteries seems right at you finger tips, but you are still looking for a keystone kernel to expand your school of thought? Well, then this might be just the episode for you.


I touch base with Chance from The Innerverse Podcast. We discuss the symbolism of the placenta, chat about the etymology of a few names, go into a little about the Cosmic Egg and, maybe even dance with dragons.


You curious about Mary, Diana, Luna or Selena? Does the "mar" and "mer" stand out to you, as much as it provokes us? Are you intrigued by sound healing or harmonics? Ever wondered who Abraxas is? If you answered yes to any of these questions, this might be just the episode for you.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Michelle Gibson returns for more Piercing the Veil of Illusion. Who are the Great Philanthropists and how & why are they said to be responsible for so many of the wonders of the old world in the North American historical narrative?
